refreshNotes: MY2026 carries the 2025 refresh forward with minor trim and pricing adjustments. B5 Core AWD starts ~$62,345 MSRP, B6 Core AWD ~$66,150, T8 Core AWD ~$76,200, T8 Ultra ~$83,400.
